fix: Commit all portal migration statements in a single SQLCipher transaction.

assertions: Failure throws and closes the store
Old schema definitions, user_version and message mappings remain unchanged
Removing the injected obstruction allows migration to version 9
Both historical root/latest events retained and conservative history completeness retained
Integrity check and subsequent reopen succeed

limitations: Synthetic SQL failures; not full-disk or SIGKILL injection during native profile migration.
